verdict.rationale: The evidence suggests teams can shape Trello boards around their own process. A user describes setting up an 'Idea => Doing => Done' workflow, and the docs mention workflow automation, templates and list customization such as changing list colors. Custom card data appears only through developer-built Power-Ups (card badges), not as a native custom-fields feature. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of native custom fields, documentation of configurable workflow statuses or columns as a feature, and independent hands-on corroboration of process customization.
